item.title: Fundamental Inhibition of Polyiodide Formation by a Site‐Separated Binder for Highly Stable Aqueous Zinc–Iodine Batteries
item.description:
یک بایندر پلیمری با جداسازی جایگاه‌های فعال، تشکیل پلی‌یدید را در باتری آبی Zn-I2 مهار کرده و ظرفیت و پایداری چرخه‌ای را به‌شدت بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a site-separated polymer binder that selectively confines I₂ and I⁻ at distinct side-chain groups, chemically blocking polyiodide formation at its source. This enables direct I₂/I⁻ conversion, superior rate performance (102 mAh g⁻¹ at 50 A g⁻¹), and 97.1% retention over 31,000 cycles—significantly advancing stable aqueous Zn–I₂ battery cathodes.
🏷 zinc-iodine battery · polyiodide inhibition · site-separated binder · aqueous battery · cycle stability

item.title: Sulfur-Induced Lattice Disordering in Halide Electrolytes Enables Superionic Sodium-Ion Conduction
item.description:
الکترولیت جامد هالیدی بی‌شکل با افزودن گوگرد، رسانایی یونی فوق‌بالای Na+ و عملکرد پایدار در باتری یون-سدیم تمام‌جامد را نشان می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a mixed-anion amorphous Na-ion electrolyte (TaCl5-0.5Na2S) made by ball-milling, where sulfur induces lattice disordering and flexible Ta–S–Cl networks. It achieves ultrahigh conductivity (2.9 mS/cm) and low activation energy (0.276 eV), enabling fast multidimensional Na+ transport and stable all-solid-state battery performance, establishing mixed-anion amorphization as a design strategy.
🏷 solid electrolyte · sodium-ion battery · halide electrolyte · amorphous · superionic conduction
